terra.problem: The claim that Jesus teaches in many places is from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say whether anyone is headed for water.
The claim connecting Bethsaida with water is from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The reference to a pool in another healing story needs a Scripture reference.
“Right then” adds timing the passage does not give.
The man says people look like trees; he does not say he sees blurry trees. “The first try” also implies an intention or failed attempt that the passage does not state.
